rules.summary: Moves @anthropic-ai/sdk to the newest 1.x release, the first major that sends API version 2026-10-21.

rules.quote: v1 of `@anthropic-ai/bedrock-sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/foundry-sdk`, `@anthropic-ai/aws-sdk`, and `@anthropic-ai/google-cloud-sdk` needs v1 of `@anthropic-ai/sdk`
rules.summary: A platform client package declared at the root moves to its newest v1 in the same upgrade, as v1 of each needs v1 of @anthropic-ai/sdk.

rules.quote: The AWS, Bedrock, and Foundry clients and `AnthropicVertex` throw an `AnthropicError` for a credential option they don’t authenticate with
rules.summary: A platform client given a credential option may throw in v1, which accepts only its platform’s credentials; Refit does not judge which ones that platform takes, so it stops

rules.quote: In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value.
rules.summary: The request may send temperature, top_p or top_k, which API version 2026-10-21 rejects, and Refit cannot see or remove them where they are written (an untraced client, a body built elsewhere or an opaque spread).

rules.quote: Remove the three parameters from your requests.
rules.summary: Pending (decision A, 2026-10-29): applies only with removeSampling and a quoted Anthropic sunset notice for @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.x or API version 2023-06-01. Without the parameters a request samples with the defaults (temperature 1.0), so answers can be more or less varied than with the value the code set.

data.pendingOn: a quoted Anthropic sunset notice for @anthropic-ai/sdk 0.x or API version 2023-06-01 (an sdk-sunset rule)

rules.quote: In `2026-10-21`, a request that places a `document` block directly in an `assistant` message returns a 400 error.
rules.summary: An assistant message with a document block is rejected on 2026-10-21; move the document to a user message.

rules.quote: In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends a `text` block with a non-empty `citations` array in a `user` message returns a 400 error.
rules.summary: A user message text block with citations is rejected on 2026-10-21.

rules.quote: The legacy Text Completions API is removed from the TypeScript, Go, Java, and Ruby SDKs and from the CLI.
rules.summary: Text Completions is gone from the v1 SDK; the call needs the Messages migration (API surface rules) first.
`client.models.list({ betas })` and `client.models.retrieve(id, { betas })` move to `client.beta.models` in v1.

rules.quote: An interface can’t extend a union, and a class can’t implement one. Use a type alias, or name the type of one role instead.
rules.summary: `MessageParam` is a union in v1; an interface that extends it or a class that implements it stops for review.

rules.quote: Two or more in `new Anthropic()`, or in one `withOptions()` call, throw a `TypeError`.
rules.summary: A client given two credentials throws in v1; the client stops for review.

rules.quote: `headers: { "X-Api-Key": otherKey }` in a request’s options no longer replaces the client’s key: both keys go out.
rules.summary: v1 sends the API key as `Authorization: Bearer`; code that sets or clears `X-Api-Key` stops for review.

rules.quote: The `compactionControl` option and the `@anthropic-ai/sdk/lib/tools/CompactionControl` module are gone.
rules.summary: The tool runner's `compactionControl` is gone in v1; it needs the server-side compaction form.
